crossRefs.note: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also…
He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.
The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
translations.bsb: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
translations.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
translations.asv: And for this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, because he did these things on the sabbath.
